qualification: The House passed the bill 232 to 198; the Senate vote (53 to 47) was on whether to end debate on taking the bill up and needed 60 votes, so it was not a vote on the bill itself. H.R. 7008 has two parts: a limit on members' stock purchases and a photo ID requirement to vote in federal elections (DR-98)

domain_note: The bill's first part limits members' stock trading, a matter V7 places under money, lobbying and influence (issue I043); a progress bar on the Senate's cloture vote counts under Congress, agencies and public services in its spec, since its question is the 60-vote rule
